log_level.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, or ERROR.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Empty or default uses stdout if not specified in template logic, but here we parametrize the path.

theme.description: Name of the theme installed in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/profanity/themes.

accounts.description: List of XMPP accounts to configure.

accounts.items.description: FLAT map item for account. Note: Since list items in JSON schema often require objects, but we are restricted to flat map for items definition. We interpret 'accounts' as a list of objects where the keys are defined below. Wait, the prompt says 'For a list-of-objects, add items as a FLAT map field-name -> {type, default, description}'. So we define the fields of the object here.

accounts.server.description: Server address for the XMPP account.

accounts.password.description: Password for the XMPP account. Note: Proficiency usually handles this securely, but for config generation we parametrize the value.

accounts.auto_join.description: Whether to auto-join groupchats stored in bookmarks for this account.
